description: Point-in-time LQ45 constituents with index weight and shares outstanding, monthly (1st of each calendar month). Dates are AS-OF: a lookup at time t must take the newest snapshot dated <= t. Reviews take effect on the first TRADING day of Feb/May/Aug/Nov, so a review appears in the FOLLOWING month's snapshot — a lag of up to ~4 weeks, which is safe (staleness withholds information rather than leaking it). `weight` is percent and sums to 100 per snapshot; `shares` is millions; `price` is the unadjusted traded price and is present in only some snapshots. Read via data/index-members.js — do not hand-edit.
source: Bloomberg per-month LQ45 member exports (Ticker / Name / Weight / Shares / Price)
notes: Membership is monthly but LQ45 reviews are quarterly (effective the first trading day of Feb/May/Aug/Nov); intervening months simply repeat the standing list.
`price` is populated in roughly half the source files. Never depend on it — the backtest takes prices from its own history file, which is split- and dividend-adjusted.

USE `weight`, NOT `shares`, as the cap-prior input. `weight` is internally consistent (sums to 100 per snapshot) and is already the free-float-adjusted number the index uses. `shares` appears to be INDEX shares and carries a methodology break where IDX adopted free-float weighting mid-sample: TLKM reads 100.8bn in 2016 and 40.0bn in 2026, and BBRI rises 162% across its 2017 split. Reconstructing market cap from it would be wrong in a way that is easy to miss. It is kept for provenance and cross-checking only.
